_comment: Copy to config.json beside this file, or point CUMULI_CONFIG at it.
Every key can also be set by an environment variable; see cumuli_bridge/settings.py.
Defaults run everything in ComfyUI's own environment: conda_env and python_exe are
empty, so child processes are started with this interpreter. Set conda_env to launch
4DAnyone from a different environment instead (the pre-merge arrangement).
data_dir and model_dir are resolved against fdanyone_root when relative.
sam3d_weights is a file name looked up in ComfyUI's models/detection folders, or a full path.
Entries in subprocess_env are read by 4DAnyone and its libraries, not by this pack.
